snippet.title: Dark Hours - Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Dark Hours, the co-op horror heist game is finally coming to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out. Available April 22 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
